title: Core affine alternating Cech resolution data
statement: Fix shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], rings A and B, a quasi-compact separated f:X→Spec A, g:Spec B→Spec A, a finite affine open cover U:Fin r→X.Opens with supremum top, a quasi-coherent X-module G, and additive tensor pullbacks along g and p=pullback.fst f g. There exist a homotopy complex D, an augmentation a:G[0]→D, and an isomorphism q:f_*D≅the homotopy image of affineAlternatingCechModel f U G [def-pc-affine-alternating-cech-model]. The localized augmentations Qh(a) and Qh(p*(a)) and the right-derived units for f at D and pullback.snd f g at p*D are invertible. Moreover D is isomorphic to the homotopy quotient of an integer cochain complex C whose every term is isomorphic to a finite product of W_j.ι_*(G restricted to W_j) for affine opens W:Fin n→X.Opens; n=0 is allowed.

proof.text: Construct the increasing-tuple Cech complex, contract it by insertion of a cover index, and use affine pushforward acyclicity and derived-unit compatibility to obtain the four isomorphisms and the affine tilde comparison. Retain C as the representative and enumerate its finite increasing-tuple intersections by Fin n in each degree; negative and out-of-range degrees use the empty product.

theorem affineAlternatingCech_resolution_core
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)
    (haffine : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i))
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive]
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G] :
    ∃ (D : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (a : (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G ⟶ D)
      (q : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D ≅
        (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (affineAlternatingCechModel f U G)),
      IsIso (DerivedCategory.Qh.map a) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
        (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace))).map
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map a)) ∧
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app D) ∧
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
        (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D)) ∧
      (∃ C : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        Nonempty (D ≅ (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C) ∧
        ∀ k : ℤ, ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → X.Opens),
          (∀ j, IsAffineOpen (W j)) ∧
          Nonempty (C.X k ≅ ∏ᶜ fun j : Fin n ↦
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (W j).ι).obj (G.restrict (W j).ι)))
